newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.18 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.18 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 27.180 to the dollar after Monday's fixing at 27.360, and at 17.822 to the mark from 17.874.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +2.18 percent after a deviation of +1.77 on Monday.
During the minute when the central bank calculated the fix, the crown was trading on the interbank market at +2.10 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
